text: 创业板指跌超4%，沪指跌超1.76%，深成指跌3.25%，算力硬件、贵金属、消费电子、农业等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近4900只
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell more than 4%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell more than 1.76%, and the Shenzhen Component Index fell 3.25%, with computing power hardware, precious metals, consumer electronics, agriculture and other sectors leading the declines; nearly 4,900 stocks fell across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
